name: modern-member-balance
finalText:
I couldn't retrieve the balance, account type, or member ID for M-1001, because the page at http://localhost:8080/modern.html never loaded.

I tried to navigate to it four times. Each attempt failed with "Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation." The tab then landed on `chrome-error://chromewebdata/`, which is Chrome's internal error page. Reading the page text returned only that URL, and a screenshot was blank. So I had no member page to read before or after acting.

This usually means nothing is serving on localhost:8080, or the server is refusing connections. I didn't guess at any values.

If you start the server or give me a different URL, I'll try again.
